mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour BTC close crossing the causally visible canonical Ichimoku 9/26/52 cloud marks price acceptance beyond a multi-horizon equilibrium envelope; follow the breakout direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict close crossover above the visible cloud top; short on a strict crossover below the visible cloud bottom
mechanism.why_distinct: Donchian uses one recent raw boundary, moving-average candidates use price means, and Aroon uses extrema recency. HVICHI uses two midpoint horizons combined into a forward-displaced cloud whose value visible now was fixed twenty-six completed bars earlier; it uses no fitted threshold, OI, flow, volume, funding, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour causal displaced-equilibrium cloud breakouts are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.tenkan: midpoint of highest high and lowest low over latest 9 completed bars
features.kijun: same midpoint over latest 26 completed bars
features.visible_cloud: at current decision use source span A/B computed exactly 26 completed bars earlier; no future shift read
features.breakout: current close crosses strictly from at-or-below prior visible top to above current visible top, or from at-or-above prior visible bottom to below current visible bottom
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical causally visible displaced cloud breakout under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no Ichimoku period, displacement, cloud boundary, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Goichi Hosoda, canonical Ichimoku Kinko Hyo convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: Tenkan 9 midpoint, Kijun 26 midpoint, Senkou A midpoint of Tenkan/Kijun displaced 26 periods forward, Senkou B 52 midpoint displaced 26 periods forward; close cloud breakout
external_basis.selection_use: published periods, displacement, and breakout direction only; no incidence or outcomes
